purpose: Check every named booklet case/example for omitted useful evidence and correct scope/date errors while preserving readable grouped explanations.

River Wye.booklet_claims: 700 m descent; upland Wales; Hereford; Bristol Channel
River Wye.decision: Added approximate descent; retain named source Plynlimon, settlements and precise Severn Estuary outlet.

River Wye.booklet_claims: Upper habitats, rapids, farming, salmon, woodland and tourism
River Wye.decision: Retained downstream process table; added Hay festival, irrigation, historic charcoal and shipbuilding. Do not assert an unnamed removed waterfall or a universal limestone upper course.
Added textbook estimate of 9,000 at-risk properties. Textbook population concerns the Wye AND Usk valleys, so do not assign it to Wye alone.
Retain Livox and restoration explanation. Do not call Tintern an unrestricted activity centre without access confirmation.

River Wye.booklet_claims: Letton Lakes; 20% afforestation reduction; Elan releases 110 days
River Wye.decision: Retain zoning, interception, slope stability and named NFM pilot with dates/140 landowners. Exact percentages and release schedule lack a securely identified event/baseline; do not claim reservoirs simply stop Wye water.

North Norfolk.booklet_claims: Chalk, flint, glacial clay; Holkham; Blakeney; Stiffkey
North Norfolk.decision: Added named contrasts and sediment/dune links; retain cliff processes.

North Norfolk.booklet_claims: January 2013 surge at Blakeney and Wells
North Norfolk.decision: Correct to 5–6 December 2013; retain named locations and distinguish flooding from erosion.

North Norfolk.booklet_claims: Shipden and Keswick lost in last century
North Norfolk.decision: Do not repeat inaccurate universal date: these are historical losses over different periods. Use documented Happisburgh retreat.

North Norfolk.booklet_claims: Sheringham rock armour; Cromer sea wall; Holkham boardwalks; Sea Palling
North Norfolk.decision: Retain/strengthen named examples. Sea Palling beach retention is linked to offshore breakwaters, not sea wall alone. Hunstanton gabions/Wells groynes require site/date-specific confirmation; avoid mislabelling current defences.

North Norfolk.booklet_claims: Fishing, flint buildings, farmland and beach huts
North Norfolk.decision: Retain tourism, fishing, farmland and homes as assets; core physical/management explanation takes precedence over an unsupported harbour claim.

source_links: Primary and supporting verification links are listed in the canonical notes; school-booklet climate approximations retain their approximate status.
presentation: Short explanatory paragraphs with bold lead-ins; no duplicated summary bullets before expanded prose. Preserve comparison tables, useful diagrams and genuine method/process lists.
